title: Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai

thread.title: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day • Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai - Episode 13 discussion - FINAL

opinions.point: Many viewers found the finale emotionally effective, especially its reflective and ultimately hopeful tone.
Ari’s character-focused emotional development was widely appreciated.
Several commenters praised the character writing, voice acting, music, and emotional impact of the series.
Some viewers felt the episode was too heavily centered on Ari, leaving Mimi and Sheena with very little screen time.
A few viewers thought the episode felt more like an OVA or epilogue after the previous episode seemed like the real finale.
Many comments criticized Crunchyroll for missing or delayed English subtitles at release.
Viewers liked the season overall but felt the ending left major world and story questions unresolved and wanted a second season.
